description: This file contains extension methods for accessing Orleans stream providers from grains, grain bases, and clients, providing convenient methods to retrieve stream providers by name.

classes.name: GrainStreamingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for retrieving stream providers from Grain and IGrainBase instances.

classes.name: ClientStreamingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for retrieving stream providers from IClusterClient instances.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider (for Grain)
methods.description: Retrieves the stream provider with the specified name from a Grain instance.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider (for IGrainBase)
methods.description: Retrieves the stream provider with the specified name from an IGrainBase instance.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider (for IClusterClient)
methods.description: Retrieves the stream provider with the specified name from an IClusterClient instance.
